hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qE "__version__|^[[:space:]]*version[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[\"']" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage": "Version string edited in %s \u2014 keep pyproject.toml ([project].version) and PyCodeCommenter/__init__.py (__version__) in sync."}' "$f"; fi
